Proposed: absent in Replay's CmdBufState; owner to confirm
structs.notes: Resolved: the Replay CmdBufState is the 4280-byte base of the proven ComputeCmdBufState (4328) and GfxCmdBufState (10368). Every member Replay touches is placed: cmdBufData, the barrier array, the transition count, labelCount, dispatchOrDraw, descState, commandSignatureType, constantBufferAllocations. Note for the owner: the computeCtx object in R_InitComputeCmdBufState and R_ComputeCmd_Finish is the ComputeCmdBufState (4328), so the separate ComputeContextData packet is probably the same family; not decided here. The apply step must resize CmdBufState from 2504 to 4280, which changes the size of any by-value embedding (none found: embedded_in is empty, typed_globals empty).
